scene: You reach the windmill catwalk high above the windy city.
picture: A wooden catwalk platform runs along the bottom. On the far left, a brass telescope points down. In the centre, the mustachioed man stands in his red poncho and straw hat with guitar on back. Up high, a large canvas sail sweeps across. On the far right stands a closed round wooden door.
shown: a mounted brass telescope pointing downward on the far left of the catwalk
a massive canvas windmill sail sweeping close by up high
a closed round wooden door set into the windmill tower on the far right
